svg.title: Silhouette halls backdrop, night 6: bunk to cold store
svg.desc: Silhouette halls backdrop for night 6, bunk to cold store: the tall hall side-on as a lit cream sheet, windows at 3.5 m throwing light long and down, the pipe run at 2.7 m, claw marks higher than a man; laundry sheets hung across the way, three drains breathing cold, the cold store's wheel door and the hatched stair door the floor plan said had to be there.
